      • setDisplayJSON

        public void setDisplayJSON​(IItemCustomizable item,
                           String displayFile)
        Description copied from class: AbstractGeckoAPI
        Set the display JSON file for a gecko item. The file is loaded from assets/{domain}/item_displays/ folders. This controls how the 3D model is positioned, rotated, and scaled in each render context (first person, third person, inventory, ground).

        Example: GeckoAPI.setDisplayJSON(item, "sword.json")

        Specified by:
        setDisplayJSON in class AbstractGeckoAPI
        Parameters:
        item - The item to set the display JSON on
        displayFile - The display JSON filename (e.g. "sword.json")

      • setItemDisplay

        public void setItemDisplay​(IItemCustomizable item,
                           String context,
                           float tx,
                           float ty,
                           float tz,
                           float rx,
                           float ry,
                           float rz,
                           float sx,
                           float sy,
                           float sz)
        Description copied from class: AbstractGeckoAPI
        Set the display transform for a specific render context on a gecko item. This controls how the 3D model is positioned, rotated, and scaled when rendered in that context.

        If no per-context transform is set, the item's existing rotation/scale/translate properties are used as fallback.

        Specified by:
        setItemDisplay in class AbstractGeckoAPI
        Parameters:
        item - The item to set the display transform on
        context - The render context: "first_person", "third_person", "inventory", or "ground"
        tx - Translation X
        ty - Translation Y
        tz - Translation Z
        rx - Rotation X (degrees)
        ry - Rotation Y (degrees)
        rz - Rotation Z (degrees)
        sx - Scale X
        sy - Scale Y
        sz - Scale Z
